ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.2:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity contiguous area at the distal tip of the right lobe; diffuse mottling and medium-intensity speckling across the upper two-thirds of the right lobe; left lobe is predominantly uniform low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression at the central lobe junction with a calculated angle of approximately 130 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels present along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe leading edge exhibits a predominantly linear sweep; left lobe exhibits a pronounced convex curve towards the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of circular high-contrast white spots (diameter 4-8 pixels) located near the median notch and across the medial surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 5-7 parallel, vertically-oriented high-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) concentrated in the lower central fluke region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct parallel rake marks in the lower-central fluke region and significant irregular serration/chipping along the trailing edge.
